            \(\begin{matrix}Perimeter: P=\\4s\\Area\\: A=\end{matrix}\begin{matrix}{s}^{2}\end{matrix}\)	

            Triangle	

[Figure: No Alt Text]

            \(\begin{matrix}Perimeter: P=a+b+\\c\\Area\\: A=\\\frac{1}{2}bh\\Sum\\of Angles: A+B+C=180°\end{matrix}\)	

            Right Triangle	

[Figure: No Alt Text]

            \(\begin{matrix}\\Pythagorean Theorem: {a}^{2}+{b}^{2}=\\{c}^{2}\\Area\\: A=\end{matrix}\begin{matrix}\frac{1}{2}ab\end{matrix}\)	

            Circle	

[Figure: No Alt Text]

            \(\begin{matrix}&C=\\2πr\\Circumference\\:\\or\\&C\\=\\πd\\Area\\: A=\end{matrix}\begin{matrix}π{r}^{2}&\end{matrix}\)	

            Parellelogram	

[Figure: No Alt Text]

            \(\begin{matrix}Perimeter: P=2a+\\2b\\Area\\: A=\end{matrix}\begin{matrix}bh\end{matrix}\)	

            Trapezoid	

[Figure: No Alt Text]

            \(\begin{matrix}Perimeter: P=a+b+c+\\B\\Area\\: A=\frac{1}{2}(B+b)\end{matrix}\begin{matrix}h\end{matrix}\)
